propertiesForm.filtersHint: Without filters, the journey starts on every occurrence of the event.
propertiesForm.pairConflict: The chosen channel is of type {{actual}}. This filter can never match; remove one of the two.

inbox_id.label: Channel
inbox_id.help: Only fires when the event comes from this channel.

pipeline_id.label: Pipeline
pipeline_id.help: Only fires for cards in this pipeline.

pipeline_stage_id.label: Pipeline stage
pipeline_stage_id.help: Choose the pipeline first to list its stages.

is_lead.label: Is lead
is_lead.help: Checked: only cards that entered as a lead.

assigned_by_id.label: Assigned by (user id)
assigned_by_id.help: Only fires when this agent made the assignment.

attributeName.label: Attribute name
attributeName.help: The key of the custom attribute that changed.

attributeValue.label: New attribute value
attributeValue.help: The value the attribute now holds.

oldValue.label: Previous value
oldValue.help: The value the attribute had before.

changeType.label: Change type
changeType.help: How the attribute changed (created, updated or removed).

activity_type.label: Activity type
activity_type.help: The type of the activity logged on the conversation.

content.label: Content
content.help: Exact text of the message or activity.

message_type.label: Message direction
message_type.help: incoming (from the contact) or outgoing (from the team).

previous_status.label: Previous status
previous_status.help: The message status before this change.

external_error.label: Provider error
external_error.help: The error message the provider returned.

reason.label: Reason
reason.help: The reason given for the deletion or the handoff.

response_time_seconds.label: Response time (s)
response_time_seconds.help: Seconds until the team's first reply.

campaign_id.label: Campaign (id)
campaign_id.help: Only fires for messages of this campaign.

template_id.label: Template (id)
template_id.help: Only fires for messages sent with this template.

url.label: Clicked URL
url.help: The exact URL the contact clicked.

product.label: Product
product.help: The product name as the platform sends it.

amount.label: Amount
amount.help: In the currency unit (e.g. 197.5), never cents.

platform_event.label: Platform event
platform_event.help: The event name as the platform sent it.

outcome.label: CRM outcome
outcome.help: created (new card) or already_in_pipeline (purchase appended to the open card).

new_contact.label: New contact
new_contact.help: Checked: the purchase created the contact.

identifier.label: External identifier
identifier.help: The contact's identifier in another system.

location.label: Location
location.help: The location stored on the contact.

contact_type.label: Contact type
contact_type.help: Visitor, lead or customer, as classified in the CRM.

created_via.label: Created by
created_via.help: Whether an agent or the system (channel, import, webhook) created the contact.

contact_created.description: A new contact was created in the CRM.

contact_label_added.description: A label was applied to a contact.

contact_label_removed.description: A label was removed from a contact.

contact_custom_attribute_changed.description: A custom attribute of the contact changed value.

conversation_created.description: A new conversation was opened on a channel.

conversation_resolved.description: A conversation was marked as resolved.

conversation_activity.description: An activity was logged on a conversation (note, assignment, status change).

conversation_first_reply.description: The team replied for the first time on a conversation.

conversation_reply_time.description: The reply time of a conversation was measured.

conversation_bot_handoff.description: The bot handed the conversation over to the team.

conversation_bot_resolved.description: The bot resolved the conversation without the team.

message_created.description: A message was sent or received on a conversation.

message_delivered.description: A sent message was delivered to the contact.

message_read.description: The contact read a sent message.

message_failed.description: Sending a message failed at the provider.

campaign_triggered.description: A contact entered a pipeline as a card (by lead, campaign or assignment).

campaign_message_sent.description: A campaign message was sent to a contact.

campaign_message_opened.description: The contact opened a campaign message.

campaign_message_clicked.description: The contact clicked a link in a campaign message.

custom.description: An event you define, with free-form properties.
